central_question: How does a managed Start, Sync and Complete migration reduce copy work while leaving schema validation, application cutover and recovery with the operator?
claims_and_limits: The November 4 AWS announcement covers eligible Glue-registered Hive Parquet tables in the same account and Region, in selected AWS Regions.
Source workloads can keep running during the main copy; final source-write pause and cutover are operator-coordinated. A few minutes is AWS's description, not a duration guarantee.
The destination is read-only until Complete. Complete cannot be undone through the service; failed or cancelled migrations may leave committed destination data.
The source object overwrite limitation and uncopied Glue metadata constrain equivalence. Conversion has no separate fee, while copied data and subsequent usage are billable.

visual.shared_motif: Blue Parquet transfer from a live Hive/Glue source to an Iceberg destination. The cover uses a bridge; the inner artwork uses a migration desk with Start, Sync, Complete and pre-cutover verification.
